title: docmap.nvim interface catalog
description: One locale of the interface: lua/docmap/core/i18n/<locale>.json. The contract is docs/i18n.md; TESTS/i18n_catalog_spec.lua checks what a schema cannot (sorted keys written once, placeholders and plural shape against the source, completeness per tier).

locale.description: The locale code, the same as the file name without .json: a language (de) or a language with a region (pt-BR).

name.description: The endonym a language picker shows: Deutsch, never German.

tier.description: source: en, every text is written here first. maintained and contributed: someone who reads the language reviews changes; such a catalog is complete. machine: generated and unreviewed; shipped only behind an opt-in and marked as such in the interface.

messages.description: Key to message. One message per line, the keys sorted.

oneOf.description: The text, with named placeholders: {from} requires {to}.
Plural forms by CLDR category, chosen by the parameter count.
